Headline: #70 Division buses Temporary Reroute at Division/Kedzie
ShortDescription: #70 Division buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to construction near Division/Kedzie.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#70 Division buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Division, Homan, Grand, Augusta, Kedzie, Division and over the regular route due to construction near Division/Kedzie.

Allow extra travel time.
